card.name: Final piece of brand drug names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a capitalized brand drug name, such as ADDYI, FRAGMIN, COSENTYX or REPATHA, when the name is repeated as the subject of a sentence in dosing instructions.

modes.label: Brand name ending
modes.description: Final piece of an all-caps brand name being repeated in prescribing text.

modes.label: Other repeated terms
modes.description: Occasional non-drug terms in technical text where a word is repeated.

card.plain: It fires on the end of an uppercase brand drug name when the label names the product again in a sentence.
